caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass bowl placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The bowl is wide and shallow with gently sloping sides that flare outward, and it features a slightly raised circular base. Subtle blue-gray shading is used to indicate the transparency and reflective quality of the glass, creating a sense of three-dimensionality. The drawing is minimalistic, containing no other objects or background details. The artist’s signature, "V. L. Vance," appears in small text to the right of the bowl.
title: Glass Sauce Dish
